kind_of_no: duplicate of Kings Kamp (one operation); own lots are a mobile-home community with no posted nightly rate
why: kingskamp.com/captain-jax/ (read 2026-10-30): 'Captain Jax is located right next door to Kings Kamp RV park. We offer 55 sites, Marina and boat ramp', with Kings Kamp's phone 305-451-0010 and email and no rate or booking of its own. The joint map (KK-CJ-Map PDF) splits the property with a line into two lot series, 1-55 north (Captain Jax) and 1-60 south (Kings Kamp), around one shared office, and the 2026 joint rules head both addresses (103620/103650). Kings Kamp's rate table covers only its own lots 1-60. MHVillage lists Captain Jax Trailer Resort as a 24-site mobile home park, and an active MLS listing (A12015690) sells a 1981 mobile home in 'Captain Jax Mobile' with association approval and the land not conveying. 2024-11 orthophoto shows the north half mostly roofed-over mobile homes. The RV nights sold here are Kings Kamp's, already in results/kings-kamp.json.
name: Captain Jax RV Resort and Marina
flags: Separate lots, one operation. Captain Jax has its own 55-lot series north of the dividing line on the joint map, and its own Google place ('Captain Jax Mobile RV Park', 4.2/121, 103650 Overseas Hwy). But it has no office, phone, email, website, rate table or booking channel of its own: Google's website for it is kingskamp.com/captain-jax/, RV Life's is keylargo@kingskamp.com, the rules sheet is shared, and Kings Kamp rents out a unit there ('Captain Jax Apt #12 F'). The two halves adjoin within ~150 m, well under the ~1 km split rule, so they belong in one entry.

Captain Jax on its own would fail long-stay tests 2 and 5. No nightly rate for its lots is published anywhere. Homes there are sold with association approval (MLS A12015690, 2026: $1,750 association fee, land does not convey). MHVillage counts 24 mobile-home sites. Satellite (Esri Wayback 2024-11 orthophoto, release 63116, z19 at 25.14010,-80.40200, rendered, read 2026-10-30) shows the canal lots mostly as roofed-over mobile homes, with a few RVs mixed in.

RV Life's 7 Captain Jax reviews (Nov 2025-Sep 2026: motorhomes, a travel trailer and a fifth wheel, $100-$135 a night, 'site right next to the beach', 'private beach', 'very tight') quote the same rates as Kings Kamp's table and describe its beach. They read as stays at the joint operation under the other name. Worth adding to the Kings Kamp entry's evidence: a 2026 reviewer stayed 3 nights; the fifth-wheel and motorhome reviewers called the sites very tight; a March 2026 reviewer complained about the front-office staff.
If AWH wants the north half covered, add nothing new. The Kings Kamp entry's phone and email are the booking channel for both halves.
